content_units: Kyoto Dinner Fit for Your Group

For   5 people near Gion-Shijo Station around 19:00  , the strongest match is   Option D  . It best satisfies the priorities in order: vegetarian-friendly Japanese food, budget cap, walking limit, and a quiet setting.
Restaurant Comparison Table
Option   Walk from Gion-Shijo Station   Avg Price pp   Vegetarian Fit   Atmosphere at 19:00   Best for
A   8 min   JPY 3,500   Vegetarian set menu available   Usually quiet   Best balance of convenience and comfort
B   12 min   JPY 4,300   Two vegetarian dishes   Lively   Least suitable for your stated needs
C   6 min   JPY 2,800   Vegetarian items marked   Moderate noise   Lowest cost, but weaker for a quiet dinner
D   14 min   JPY 3,900   Full vegetarian course available   Quiet   Best overall match for the group
Best Pick for 19:00 in Gion
Option 1:   Option D     Full vegetarian course, quiet atmosphere, still within budget and walking limit     Best overall
- Strongest vegetarian offering among the four.
- Quiet atmosphere is a better fit for a group dinner at 19:00.
- At   JPY 3,900 per person  , total estimated food cost for 5 is   JPY 19,500  .
- The   14-minute walk   is within your limit, though it is the farthest acceptable option.
Option 2:   Option A     Very solid backup with vegetarian set menu and shorter walk     Best convenience
- Easier walk at   8 minutes  .
- Quiet and comfortably under budget at   JPY 3,500 per person  .
- Slightly weaker than D only because the vegetarian offering sounds narrower than a full vegetarian course.
- Estimated total for 5:   JPY 17,500  .
Option 3:   Option C     Cheapest and closest, but less ideal for a calm group dinner     Budget backup
- Best on price at   JPY 2,800 per person  .
- Only   6 minutes   away.
- Downsides:   no reservations   and   moderate noise  , which adds risk for a 5-person dinner at 19:00.
Why Option D Wins
Your priorities point clearly to   D  :
-   Vegetarian-friendly:   best option because it offers a   full vegetarian course
-   Budget:   fits under   JPY 4,000 per person
-   Distance:   fits under   15 minutes
-   Quiet atmosphere:   explicitly quiet, which matters more than shaving a few walking minutes
Not recommended:     Option B
- Over budget at   JPY 4,300 per person
- Atmosphere is lively, not quiet
- Vegetarian choice is limited to only two dishes
Quick Actions
Choose Option D
Backup Option A
Planning Notes

Using the details you provided, I assumed all four options serve Japanese food and are available around   19:00  . Because   D says reservation recommended   and your group has   5 people  , it is the safest pick operationally as well.
